Thank you @WhereonEarth for creating such a fascinating travel documentary on Southern Italy! Highlighting hidden gems like Calabria, Matera, and Puglia shows a side of the country most tourists completely overlook. The stunning 4K visuals, rich historical context, and deep cultural insights make this exploration truly captivating. Outstanding work on showcasing these incredible southern regions! 🇮🇹🇮🇹🇮🇹
